source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.post_action: Commercial post from an account with zero prior actions is a 'first offence', which the domain says gets a soft hold rather than removal.
reasons.scam_likelihood: Gift-card-only payment, no refunds, fake followers, new unverified account: strong scam signals.

reasons.post_action: Fake-follower sale with gift-card-only payment from a new unverified account warrants removal; some chance of escalation.
reasons.scam_likelihood: Gift-card-only payment, no refunds, new unverified account and multiple scam reports are strong scam signals.

ui_dependence: The terminology defines a soft hold and a first-offence rule that favours it over removal; without those definitions removal is the more natural answer.
